Self.Wiki: This map object represents a world map point in the map. It has two areas: the discovery area, where the player discovers the point, and the re-entry area. Each is either a separate region (World Map Discovery Point / World Map Re-entry Point) or this region's own shape expanded by the ranges below.

DiscoveryRegionName.Wiki: A World Map Discovery Point region whose shape becomes this point's discovery area. Empty: the discovery area is this region's shape, expanded by the Discovery Expand Range fields.

DiscoveryExpandRangeXZ.Wiki: Horizontal expansion of this region's shape for the discovery area, in metres. Negative: GameSystemCommonParam worldMapPointDiscoveryExpandRange.

DiscoveryExpandRangeY.Wiki: Vertical expansion of this region's shape for the discovery area, in metres. Negative: GameSystemCommonParam worldMapPointDiscoveryExpandRange.

ReentryRegionName.Wiki: A World Map Re-entry Point region whose shape becomes this point's re-entry area. Empty: the re-entry area is this region's shape, expanded by the Re-entry Expand Range fields.

ReentryExpandRangeXZ.Wiki: Horizontal expansion of this region's shape for the re-entry area, in metres. Negative: GameSystemCommonParam worldMapPointReentryExpandRange.

ReentryExpandRangeY.Wiki: Vertical expansion of this region's shape for the re-entry area, in metres. Negative: GameSystemCommonParam worldMapPointReentryExpandRange.
